amendment_log.reason: The nx migration (commit e29624c) ported the host runtime into libs/host-runtime but left a duplicate live copy under scripts/host/ — two ProcessSupervisor symbols, two loadFromLockfile flows, duplicate activate* adapters and McpRegistrar. C6 must enforce declared permissions ONCE in the single canonical runtime. Inserted consolidate-legacy as the new root state to delete the superseded scripts/host/** tree (and scripts/host-runtime.test.ts, scripts/host-delivery.test.ts) so libs/host-runtime is the sole runtime; re-wired policy-core and audit-foundation depends_on onto it. This also resolves the gap-check --discover duplicate caller-mapping FAILs (the deleted symbols then exist only in libs/host-runtime + doc prose). docs/architecture-audit-v2.md is reserved read_only (prose mentions only).

Deletion of scripts/host/runtime-cli.ts introduced a real regression: bin/sox start/stop/exec (3 sites) and tools/test-e2e-lifecycle.js (host-runtime:test-e2e nx target) all spawned that deleted file via 'npx tsx scripts/host/runtime-cli.ts'. The consolidate guard (nx run-many -t test) did not catch this because test-e2e is a separate nx target not covered by run-many -t test. Fix: recreate the CLI as libs/host-runtime/src/runtime-cli.ts (canonical artifact, imports from ./runtime.js/./loader.js/./registrar.js), compiled to libs/host-runtime/dist/runtime-cli.js by the existing host-runtime build target (tsc src/**). Re-point all 3 bin/sox spawner sites and tools/test-e2e-lifecycle.js to spawn: process.execPath + [libs/host-runtime/dist/runtime-cli.js, verb, ...args] — no npx, no tsx, compiled artifact only. Approach chosen: recreate (not reuse apps/sox) because apps/sox exposes no start/stop/status/exec CLI verbs; the compiled dist entry is the minimal, cleanest diff. Proof: nx run host-runtime:test-e2e = 33/33 PASS, zero orphan processes after stop.
